subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw core add a default-off TUI run-completion notification surface, and if so which modes should be supported first: terminal bell only, desktop notification, or both?
rationale: The request adds new user-facing behavior and new TUI config surface rather than fixing an existing contract, and AGENTS.md sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces.

options.title: Start with terminal bell
options.body: Add a minimal default-off terminal-bell mode first, leaving platform desktop notifications for a later explicit design.

options.title: Design desktop notifications now
options.body: Add macOS desktop notification support alongside config and security constraints before implementation starts.

options.title: Keep notifications external
options.body: Keep core TUI visual-only and rely on nodes notify, scripts, plugins, or the broader watchdog issue for alerting.

recommendation.title: Start with terminal bell
recommendation.body: Add a minimal default-off terminal-bell mode first, leaving platform desktop notifications for a later explicit design.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main signal on the present TUI/config snapshot and recent adjacent TUI terminal behavior.
